home.faq1q: Where do I find my tyre size?
home.faq1a: It's printed on the tyre sidewall, e.g. 205/55 R16 91V: 205 is the width in mm, 55 the sidewall height (as % of the width), R16 the rim diameter in inches. It's also in the service book or on the driver's door sticker.
home.faq2q: What do the load and speed indexes mean?
home.faq2a: In 91V, 91 is the load index (615 kg per tyre) and V the speed index (240 km/h max). Choose indexes at least equal to those specified for your vehicle.
home.faq3q: Do you deliver everywhere in France?
home.faq3a: Yes, we deliver to your home anywhere in mainland France. The price shown includes delivery. You can also have your tyres fitted at our partner workshop in Barr.
